observations: Blue and black high-pressure water machine.
Power cord is coiled around the body.
Water outlet nozzle is visible at the top.
The machine is sitting on a light-colored wooden surface.
A watermark 'DANCO' and 'TEXTURES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: pre-certified to work at the peak of their performance
claims.evidence: Requires a video of the machine running and the nozzle spraying water.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal leaks.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and the nozzle spraying water at high pressure.

risks.risk: The pressure rating (e.g., 150bar, 200bar) is unknown, which significantly affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's rating plate, usually on the back or side of the unit.

risks.risk: The motor may be noisy or have electrical faults.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through its full pressure range.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the rating plate on the back or side of the machine.
Video of the machine plugged in and spraying water.
Photo of the nozzle tip to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
